observations_not_defects: adb shell input text cannot type CJK (input-injection limitation); smoke used ASCII query text. mock echoes query verbatim; slots/plan/results carry fixed Chinese fixtures.

a swipe performed while Gboard was open glide-typed ' by' into the query field AFTER the search had executed; actual POST /queries body verified clean ('2024 tsinghua advanced math mcq' + limit:10). No app defect; tooling artifact.

Chrome on this emulator had never been launched: ACTION_VIEW lands on firstrun.FirstRunActivity instead of a page load. ToS not accepted (no Chrome-side page load or request; unrelated OS-level Android auto probes are documented in a separate observation below). Takeover still proven via window/activity focus transition. URL host is localhost, which never leaves the device.
home screen renders mock's non-enum privacy route strings (model_route/voice_mode/search_mode) as 未知 and booleans faithfully (否/否); /health shows 正常 — honest projection, matches design boundary.

logcat contains Android system-level automatic network traffic unrelated to this app's own networking (so 'no external network' must not be overstated to whole-device scope): NetworkMonitor (system_server PID 1169) probed connectivitycheck.gstatic.com (DNS OK; HTTP generate_204 actually served from the network, X-Android-Response-Source=[NETWORK 204]), www.google.com HTTPS and play.googleapis.com fallback (both timed out; isCaptivePortal -> isPartialConnectivity=true); Gboard (com.google.android.inputmethod.latin PID 1662) requested dictionarypack/emoji/next-word-predictor manifests from www.gstatic.com when the query field gained focus. OS/IME component behavior, not app traffic — app+mock stayed loopback-only per mock_requests.log; no AI provider or production service involved.
